purpose: The 164 canvas-settable rows whose citation confirm-canvas.mjs refuted, each checked against the Eye Care fix register and the framework DB before any W to F move (Bean asked for this check).
population: rows with decidedBy canvas-settable in sites/eye-care-ward-end/build/qa/triage at commit d112dae61, minus the 4 CONFIRMED families (CANVAS-SETTABLE-CONFIRMATION.md)
method: Three read-only readers, one per surface group, each quoting the register row verbatim and querying block_attributes for the row own block; the main thread re-read every quoted register line and each load-bearing DB claim against the files.

categories.GAP: no setting can paint this element and the register does not record it: a real, untracked framework gap
categories.TRACKED: a real gap the register already records as framework work
categories.DECIDED: the register records it as a tree fix, a decision or closed: not a framework gap
categories.KEPT-162: register 162: the error icon and ring are kept (Bean 2026-10-07)
categories.SETTING-EXISTS: a setting that paints this element exists; the row is a calibration or pairing fault
categories.NOT-REAL: no live element was found, so there is no difference to classify
categories.UNCLEAR: one computed read or source check settles it; the citation names that check

councilPrediction: Declared before the /qc-council runs: blind re-derivation agrees with these categories on at least 90% of rows in every category. A category below 90% is re-checked in full and resolved by reading the code at the cited symbol.
